mapper.select: SELECT result_id as resultId, vote_id as voteId, user_id as userId, option_id as optionId, voted_at as votedAt FROM project_post_vote_result WHERE vote_id = #{voteId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_post_vote_result (vote_id, user_id, option_id, voted_at) VALUES (#{voteId}, #{userId}, #{optionId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_post_vote_result WHERE vote_id = #{voteId} AND user_id = #{userId}
